Join the Place4Shop Affiliate Program – Earn While Promoting a Greener Future!

Are you passionate about sustainability and energy-efficient heating solutions? Do you want to earn commission while promoting high-quality electric heating and outdoor heating products? Then the Place4Shop Affiliate Program is perfect for you!

Who We Are

At Place4Shop, we are committed to creating a greener world by offering cutting-edge electric heating and terrace heating solutions that reduce CO₂ emissions. Our mission is to provide eco-friendly, energy-efficient, and cost-effective heating systems for homes, businesses, and outdoor spaces. By promoting our brand, you help contribute to a more sustainable future.

Our Products

We specialize in a wide range of electric heating solutions, including:
✅ Infrared heating panels – Energy-efficient and stylish heating for any space
✅ Electric radiators – Modern and smart-controlled heating solutions
✅ Outdoor & terrace heaters – High-performance heaters for year-round outdoor comfort
✅ Bathroom & mirror heaters – Space-saving solutions that provide warmth and elegance

Every product we offer is designed to minimize CO₂ emissions and provide maximum comfort with low energy consumption.

Why Join Our Affiliate Program?

🔹 Earn commissions effortlessly – Promote our eco-friendly heating solutions and get rewarded!
🔹 Attractive commissions – Receive 10% on the first sale of each new customer you refer and 5% on all future purchases made by that customer.
🔹 Long-term earning potential – Continue earning passive income every time your referred customers make repeat purchases.
🔹 High-demand products – Electric heating is the future, and our top-tier products sell themselves!
🔹 Sustainability-focused branding – Align yourself with a company dedicated to reducing environmental impact.

How Does It Work?

1️⃣ Sign up for our affiliate program – it’s quick and easy!
2️⃣ Get your unique referral link and start sharing it via your website, blog, social media, or email.
3️⃣ Earn 10% commission on the first sale from each new customer you refer.
4️⃣ Keep earning 5% on every future purchase they make!

💰 Start Earning Today! 💰
Join our Place4Shop Affiliate Program and turn your audience into a source of sustainable income—all while promoting eco-friendly, high-quality heating solutions.

📢 Sign up now and start making a difference! 👉 Visit Place4Shop.com
